acceptance_criteria.criterion: Trusted v1/v2 contract selection and downgrade prevention
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Contract classification and floor read candidate files only through worker.resolve_candidate_file (symlink/escape rejected before classify/compare/import/hash); v2 candidate fixture exercises v1/v2 selection, downgrade and relabel rejection.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Isolated candidate execution and fail-closed receipt verification
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Digest covers the full candidate input closure (transitive imports + docs/CODE_WRITE_POLICY.json) via one shared definition used by run and verify jobs; symlink, missing, unparseable and mutated dependencies fail closed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Preserve legacy v1 terminality, bounded collector recovery and idempotence
acceptance_criteria.evidence: v1 scenario A drives the real ensure_collector through a stale-cycle sequence (idempotence, bounded redispatch, refresh, terminal timeout, active ceiling) with mutation tests.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Preserve v2 publisher and receipt provenance rules
acceptance_criteria.evidence: v2 scenario A verifies the budget is pool-derived by mutating the pool, rejects forged/missing creators and malformed descriptions through real read_cycle/_parse_cycle; v2 scenarios run in the normal suite.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Deterministic regression and repository governance gates
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_hunter_trusted_orchestrator_replay.py: 131 passed, 0 skipped on the remediation tree; Ruff, Black, Mypy, Architecture, Artifact and Defect Prevention checks pass; exact-head hosted preflight still required.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Owner-controlled rollout without bypass or merge
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Owner-signed commit; PR remains Draft; no merge; no gate disabled; no independent clearance claimed by this author request.
